items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: Stan Getz offered me a gig that night at Carnegie Hall, right after the gig. We went up to the party afterwards because we did this thing and he played with the band, and he said when you get off this band call me.

ctx.x: But guys have told me that jeez if you were around in the 40’s and like that, like you’d be — Stan Getz offered me a gig that night at Carnegie Hall, right after the gig. We went up to the party afterwards because we did this thing and he played with the band, and he said when you get off this band call me. I never did. But I understand that he was not the most fun guy to work with.
Well I’m jealous of some of your playing experiences, because I often times think I was born a little too late. But we’re both still here. And I’m going to remember that answer.
